# Dialog

`ui.dialog` · parts: `Dialog` · elements: `<dialog>`

## Purpose

Dialog is the native <dialog>. Opening/closing (showModal) is the consumer's.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
_No additional notes for Dialog yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Dialog renders a native dialog element.

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ID` | `id` | `id` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Open` | `open` | `open` | `boolean` | — | prop | initial open state |
| `AriaLabelledBy` | `aria-labelledby` | `aria-labelledby` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaDescribedBy` | `aria-describedby` | `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaLabel` | `aria-label` | `aria-label` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-label` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-label` — static values only.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `dialogClasses({ ... })` from `dialog/dialog.shared.ts` |
| templ | `dialog.DialogClasses(dialog.DialogProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('dialogClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::dialogClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `dialog_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<dialog>Content</dialog>` |
| open | `{"Open":true,"ID":"d","AriaLabelledBy":"t","AriaDescribedBy":"desc"}` | `<dialog id="d" open aria-labelledby="t" aria-describedby="desc">Content</dialog>` |
| named | `{"AriaLabel":"Settings"}` | `<dialog aria-label="Settings">Content</dialog>` |
| Open | `{"Open":true}` | `<dialog open>Content</dialog>` |

## Usage

Fixture `open` (`{"Open":true,"ID":"d","AriaLabelledBy":"t","AriaDescribedBy":"desc"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<dialog id="d" open aria-labelledby="t" aria-describedby="desc">Content</dialog>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Dialog } from "./ui/dialog/dialog";

<Dialog open id="d" aria-labelledby="t" aria-describedby="desc">Content</Dialog>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Dialog from "./ui/dialog/Dialog.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog open id="d" aria-labelledby="t" aria-describedby="desc">Content</Dialog>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Dialog from "./ui/dialog/Dialog.svelte";
</script>

<Dialog open={true} id="d" aria-labelledby="t" aria-describedby="desc">Content</Dialog>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Dialog } from "./ui/dialog/dialog.solid";

<Dialog open id="d" aria-labelledby="t" aria-describedby="desc">Content</Dialog>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderDialog } from "./ui/dialog/dialog.wc";

document.body.append(renderDialog({ open: true, id: "d", "aria-labelledby": "t", "aria-describedby": "desc" }, "Content"));
```

```templ
@dialog.Dialog(dialog.DialogProps{Open: true, ID: "d", AriaLabelledBy: "t", AriaDescribedBy: "desc"}) {

}
```
